title: Hold a firearms dealer licence
what: In carrying on a business, make, acquire, dispose of, repair, maintain, test or store firearms or firearm parts only as a licensed firearms dealer.

sources.title: Firearms Act 1996 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 185 (current republication (R64, from 16 November 2025; Firearms Act 1996 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) in carrying on a business, the person— (i) manufactures, acquires, disposes of, repairs, maintains or tests firearms or firearm parts

sources.title: Firearms Act 1996 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 69, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current republication (R64, from 16 November 2025; Firearms Act 1996 | Acts)
sources.quote: The registrar must not issue a firearms dealer licence to an adult unless satisfied on reasonable grounds that— (a) an individual who is, or will be, a close associate of the adult is suitable;

reach.condition: if it deals in, repairs or stores firearms in the course of a business
